description: This file defines the OrderTotalItem class, a serializable model representing an item with a price and code in an order.

classes.name: OrderTotalItem
classes.description: A data model class representing an item's total in an order, including price and code.

methods.name: setItemPrice
methods.description: Sets the price of the order item.

methods.name: getItemPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the price of the order item.

methods.name: setItemCode
methods.description: Sets the code of the order item.

methods.name: getItemCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code of the order item.
